name: Ap chao
summary: Bánh áp chao is a savory afternoon fried cake: soft batter around marinated meat or duck, fried golden so it is crisp outside and soft and chewy inside.
origin: Cao Bang city, in the afternoon.
howToEat: Eat it hot with herbs, shredded green papaya, and a sweet-sour dip at an afternoon counter in the town center.
where: Afternoon counters in the town center, where hours change by the day.
